children: Wintergreen Acquisition entered into an unsecured, interest-free promissory note with its sponsor, Macro Dream Holdings, for $184,635 to fund a deposit into the trust account and extend its business combination deadline. The note matures upon the earlier of closing a business combination or liquidation and will be forgiven if no deal is completed, with the sponsor waiving any claim to trust funds. At the sponsor’s option, the unpaid principal may convert into units at $10.00 per unit upon consummation of a business combination. The extension moves the deadline to October 30, 2026 as the company pursues its merger with KIKA Technology.
